title: Ordinary exact scalar-unit copowers descend to the derived category
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite intermediate field E, an index type I, and coefficient sections b(Z,i):1 -> Omega_Z as in [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category] and [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-qbar-derived-scalar-basis-pushforward]. Assume ordinary extension of scalars preserves finite limits for every Z, and its ordinary scalar-unit legs indexed by b(Z,i) give an isomorphism from every ordinary module copower. Then the actual left-derived extension adjunction unit followed by the localized central actions gives an isomorphism from every chosen I-copower of every derived E_Z-module. Section coherence is not required for this formal descent.

proof.text: Form the ordinary adjunction unit followed by degreewise central scalar action on a complex. Evaluation preserves coproducts; sigmaComparison_map_desc and the ordinary module hypothesis make its component in every degree invertible, hence the complex map is invertible.

Use the proved upstream DerivedCategory.isColimitCofanMkQObj and quotientCompQhIso to preserve this coproduct under homotopy/derived localization. Exact-functor factorization, the adjunction-unit factorization, and localized center naturality identify each mapped leg with the termwise derived scalar-unit leg. Compare left-derived extension with exact derived extension and use central naturality to obtain the actual left-derived unit legs.

Represent the derived object by a K-injective complex, composing its representative isomorphism with quotientCompQhIso. Transport the chosen copower along the component isomorphisms. Naturality of the adjunction unit and central action identifies the transported scalar legs, and cancellation of coproduct and target isomorphisms proves the result for the original chosen copower.

proof_origin.place: C2 second reading: proved degreewise ordinary-module-to-derived descent, exact-functor/left-derived comparison, then representative transport

lean.statement:
theorem condensedQbar_scalar_basis_unit_of_sections
    (I : Type (u + 1))
    (b : ∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, I →
      (𝟙_ (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1}) ⟶
        condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) Z))
    (hexact : ∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, PreservesFiniteLimits (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap
      (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl ℓ E) Z)))
    (h : ∀ (Z : Scheme.{u})
      (N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) Z))
      [HasCoproduct (fun _ : I ↦ N)],
      IsIso (Sigma.desc (f := fun _ : I ↦ N) fun i ↦
        (Mod.extendRestrictAdjunction (coefficientMap
          (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl ℓ E) Z)).unit.app N ≫
        (Mod.comap (coefficientMap
          (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl ℓ E) Z)).map
          (Mod.qbar_scalarEndo (b Z i) ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap
            (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl ℓ E) Z)).obj N)))) :
    ∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (M : DerivedCategory
      (CategoryTheory.Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) Z)))
      [HasCoproduct (fun _ : I ↦ M)],
      IsIso (Sigma.desc (f := fun _ : I ↦ M) fun i ↦
        Mod.qbar_scalarUnitLeg (coefficientMap
          (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl ℓ E) Z) (b Z i) M)
